avis.texte: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Gentle and Perfect for Baby’s Skin The CETAPHIL Baby Gentle Wash and Shampoo (400ml) is a fantastic product for newborns and infants. It has a mild, soothing formula that cleans without drying out the skin or scalp. I love that it’s tear-free and hypoallergenic, making bath time stress-free. The addition of glycerin helps keep skin soft and hydrated, and it has a light, pleasant scent that isn’t overpowering. It lathers well and rinses off easily, leaving my baby’s skin feeling fresh and smooth. Plus, it’s dermatologist-recommended, which gives me peace of mind about safety and quality. Overall, this is a great choice for parents looking for a gentle, effective wash and shampoo combo. Highly recommend!
This is smells the best among all the brand's I have tried for my kid.
